tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Button and chip text on brand-blue and status fills.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Shadow colour only — never used as a flat fill or text colour.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one fixed brand colour, #1C6CFE. Do not shift its hue or saturation in either theme.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Text — 17.1:1 (light, neutral-900) / 18.2:1 (dark, neutral-50).

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Alternate section band (e.g. ‘How we work’, footer) that separates from bg without a hard line.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card and panel fill sitting on bg. Pair with `border` and `shadow-sm`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Card fill sitting on `bg-subtle`, or an overlay (menu, tooltip, modal) — one step lighter than its surroundings so it reads as lifted without relying on shadow alone.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Subtle, decorative edges: card outlines, table rules, dividers. Always paired with spacing or a shadow, never the sole cue for an interactive boundary.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Boundaries that ARE the cue: input, textarea, select and checkbox/radio outlines. 4.25:1 vs white, 4.01:1 vs neutral-900, 4.48:1 vs neutral-950 — clears the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 floor for non-text UI in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary reading colour. 17.05:1 on `bg`/`surface` (light), 18.21:1 on `bg` / 16.32:1 on `surface` (dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy — captions, metadata, helper text. 6.62:1 on `bg` / 6.33:1 on `bg-subtle` (light); 7.42:1 on `bg` / 6.65:1 on `surface` (dark). Never drop to a lighter step: neutral-500 on white is only 4.25:1, too tight for small helper text alongside the 6.6:1 body pairing.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill. Exactly #1C6CFE in both themes — with `primary-foreground` (white) this is 4.54:1, the AA floor for normal text, so it is never lightened further for a ‘softer’ dark-mode button.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed-adjacent fill. Darkens in both themes (never lightened) so white text stays comfortably above AA: 6.21:1.

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Active/pressed fill, one step further than hover for tactile feedback.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`, `primary-hover`, `primary-active`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline text links. Light: blue-600 on white = 4.54:1. Dark: blue-600 drops to 4.19:1 on neutral-950 — too tight — so dark mode uses the lighter blue-400 tint: 6.52:1 on `bg`, 5.84:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover/underline colour — one step further from `link` in the same direction each theme takes (darker in light, lighter in dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus-visible outline, offset 2px. 4.54:1 on white; 6.52:1 on neutral-950 / 5.84:1 on neutral-900 — clears the 3:1 non-text floor against every surface it lands on in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text/icon on `surface`. 6.72:1 (light, on white) / 7.78:1 (dark, on neutral-900).

tokens.name: success-solid
tokens.usage: Success fill (chips, solid banners). With `success-solid-foreground`: 4.88:1.

tokens.name: success-solid-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `success-solid`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text/icon on `surface`. 10.6:1 (light) / 9.81:1 (dark, on neutral-900). Amber is legible only this dark on light backgrounds — warning-400/500 both fail AA as text.

tokens.name: warning-solid
tokens.usage: Warning fill. Pairs with a DARK foreground, not white — amber cannot clear 4.5:1 with white text in either theme.

tokens.name: warning-solid-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-solid`. 8.23:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger text/icon on `surface`. 5.71:1 (light) / 5.13:1 (dark, on neutral-900).

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Danger fill (destructive buttons, error banners). With `danger-solid-foreground`: 5.71:1.

tokens.name: danger-solid-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `danger-solid`.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline only, one per page. Desktop 64/68; mobile clamps to 40/44, letter-spacing -0.01em.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title (one per page, e.g. service detail top). Mobile: 34/40.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-section heading, card group title. Mobile: 22/29.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Minor heading inside a card or list. Mobile: 17/25.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Smallest heading rank, form section title. Same size on mobile.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a heading, hero sub-copy. Mobile: 18/29.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running copy, form values, nav links. Mobile: 15/24.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, captions under form fields, metadata. Same size on mobile.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, image credits, legal fine print. Same size on mobile.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a section heading (apply text-transform:uppercase in CSS — the token stores the mixed-case source). Same size on mobile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field labels, button text at md/lg size.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Button text at sm size, badge text, nav links at rest.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and fenced code blocks in article prose.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Small technical tags: case reference numbers, version strings, the footer's phone/registration line if ever needed.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Reset.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact control padding, gap between a label and its helper text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input vertical padding, gap inside a small stack.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding on mobile, base stack gap, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Comfortable control horizontal padding (md button).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between related cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its content; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between unrelated blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between the two hero paths; footer column gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding, mobile (top and bottom).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding, tablet.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections, desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding, desktop (top and bottom) — hero and other full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed media, table cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badge, checkbox, small chip, input focus ring corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, textareas, select.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large feature cards, the hero media frame, image placeholders.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatar/founder photo, the segmented control track, the theme toggle.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Resting state of an input or a flat button — barely-there separation.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Default card and dropdown elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered card, popover.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Mobile menu sheet, modal.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill and text (paired with cursor: not-allowed and aria-disabled, never colour alone).

tokens.name: opacity-overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the mobile menu sheet and modals.
